xbrli:xbrl.in-bse-shp:DisclosureOfNotesOnShareholdi: I) Significant Beneficial Ownership: 1. Pursuant to exemption provided in SEBI Order dated December 31, 2024 bearing reference number WTM/ASB/CFD/16/2024-25 G V Prasad Transferred 9,60,95,920 (11.51%) equity shares to GVP Family Trust. Therefore, GVP family Trust holds 11.51% of the equity share capital of the Company. Pursuant to Explanation III(iv) to Rule 2(h) of Companies (Significant Beneficial Owner) Rules, 2018, Mr. G V Prasad (Trustee & settlor) Ms. Gunupati Anuradha (Trustee and beneficiary) and other beneficiaries Ms. Vani Sanjana Reddy, Ms. Gunupati Mallika Reddy and Mr Gunupati Sharathchandra Reddy of GVP Family Trust are the Significant Beneficial Owners (SBO) of the Company. In the SBO details sheet we have only mentioned only Mr G V Prasad as the SBO as the % of shareholding bifurcation cannot be given separately for each SBO. 2. Pursuant to exemption provided in SEBI Order dated December 31, 2024 bearing reference number WTM/ASB/CFD/16/2024-25 Mr. K Satish Reddy Transferred 7,56,30,620 equity shares of Rs.1/- each (9.06%) to VSD Family Trust. Therefore, VSD Family Trust holds 9.06% of the equity share capital of the Company. Pursuant to Explanation III(iv) to Rule 2(h) of Companies (Significant Beneficial Owner) Rules, 2018, Mr. K Satish Reddy, Ms Deepti Reddy Kallam (Trustees and beneficiary) and other beneficiaries Ms. Shravya Reddy and Mr. K Vishal Reddy of VSD Family Trust are the Significant Beneficial Owners (SBO) of the Company. In the SBO details sheet we have only mentioned Mr K Satish Reddy as the SBO as the % of shareholding bifurcation cannot be given separately for each SBO. II) In compliance with SEBI Circular SEBI/HO/CFD/CMD/CIR/P/2017/128 dated December 19, 2017, the shareholding is consolidated on the basis of PAN. III) There is no option of LLP in the drop down list. Hence we have selected partnership firm as the category for VSD Holdings & Advisory LLP, being the most relevant option for this entity. IV) In terms of SEBI Exemption order no. WTM/ASB/CFD/16/2024 25 dated December 31, 2024. Mr. Satish Reddy Kallam & Mrs. Deepti Reddy Kallam, Trustees of VSD Family Trust and Mr. Gunupati Venkateswara Prasad (G V Prasad) & Mrs. Anuradha Gunupati, Trustees of GVP Family Trust, have confirmed that Trusts are in compliance with said SEBI Exemption order and they have submitted the required annual compliance status certificate for period ended March 31, 2026 from Independent Auditor on April 17, 2026 to SEBI and stock exchanges. V) The Company has granted 13,14,444 ADRs underlying equity shares (stock options) to Mr Erez Israeli, Chief Executive Officer of the Company, which are outstanding as on date. These are shown as part of the No. of outstanding ESOPs granted under the Overseas Depositories category in the Shareholding pattern. VI) Basis the request received from Mr Satish Reddy Kallam and Mr Gunupati Venkateswara Prasad, Promoters of the Company, some individuals/entities have been added in the category of Promoter Group in the Shareholding Pattern. VII) All the names mentioned in the Promoter/Promoter Group are in alignment with their PAN.
